wire.settings.bash_memory_enabled.help: Give every bash command a RAM ceiling. A command whose process group crosses it is killed (its group only, never lop) so it cannot take the device down; the model is told to use less memory.

wire.settings.bash_memory_limit_mb.help: The ceiling when 'manual' is selected above. 0 means use the auto ceiling instead, so leaving this at 0 never disables the guard.
wire.settings.bash_memory_limit_mb.label: Manual ceiling (MB)
wire.settings.bash_memory_mode.help: 'auto' derives the ceiling from the memory this device has free right now, so it tightens on its own when the machine is busy. 'manual' pins it to the number below.
wire.settings.bash_memory_mode.label: Ceiling source
Fraction of the ceiling at which one advisory line is emitted. It is only an advisory — userspace cannot slow an allocation — so it warns before the kill, it does not prevent it.
Time-box a shell `grep`/`find`/`du` walk that reads the filesystem rather than a scoped file: one advisory at 10 s, then a stop at the budget below. Builds, installs and test runs are never affected.
Wall-clock budget for one shell query. The advisory fires at 10 s whatever this says; this is the stop. A per-command prefix of LOCAL_OPERATOR_ALLOW_SLOW_QUERY=1 skips the stop for a justified run.
wire.settings.bash_query_budget_stop.hel: On: a query that crosses the budget is killed and told why. Off: it runs to completion and only the advisory is shown, so an operator can watch before enforcing.

Rotated files kept before the oldest is pruned and that pruning is recorded.
wire.settings.network_audit_max_age_days: Age and size both rotate, because age binds on a quiet install and size on a busy one. Export with `lop network log --export` before pruning.
wire.settings.network_audit_max_bytes.he: Bytes per generation, after rotation. 8 MiB of gzipped JSONL is roughly 55k records; the five-generation ceiling is therefore ~40 MiB.
wire.settings.network_credentials_github: owner/repo entries a brokered GitHub token may touch (empty: none)
wire.settings.network_credentials_grant_: The longest a device may use a login it borrowed from its owner before asking again, and so how long a revoked or offline owner's login keeps working elsewhere. Never longer than the token itself.
wire.settings.network_max_handshakes.hel: Unauthenticated connections this relay will hold at once. A pairing holds one for the seconds until the code is typed; anything past the cap is dropped at accept, with no reply frame.
wire.settings.network_port.help: The port peers dial; endpoints without one use it.
wire.settings.network_port.label: Mesh port
wire.settings.network_sync_debounce_s.he: Seconds a session's transcript must stay unchanged before its owner tells devices holding a copy to pull. A session going idle pushes at once, so its final message is never held back by this.

wire.settings.proactive.title: Proactive class
wire.settings.proactive_patience_backoff: Each later wait in a cycle is at least this many times the first — the default 5/15/45-minute progression.
wire.settings.proactive_patience_default: How long a hidden wait defaults to when the agent does not size one (milliseconds; 300000 = 5 min). Clamped 60 s..24 h.
wire.settings.proactive_patience_episode: Hard stop for one cycle however the waits were sized (milliseconds; 7200000 = 2 h). A fire past it retires silently.
wire.settings.proactive_patience_max_att: How many outbound waits one cycle may hold before it must end.
wire.settings.proactive_patience_max_pen: How many hidden waits may be pending at once for one session.

wire.settings.projects.title: Projects
wire.settings.projects_stale_after_hours: A project whose progress is older than this reads stale and is worth a check-in. 1–168 hours.
wire.settings.providers.description: How direct provider connections are made: API surface and cache TTL.
wire.settings.providers.title: Wire protocol
wire.settings.providers_anthropic_cache_: Context size from which Anthropic requests use the 1-hour prompt-cache TTL (2x write cost, survives idle gaps over 5 minutes). 0 disables.
wire.settings.providers_llamacpp_base_ur: HTTP(S) API root. Changing servers requires a new token through /login; existing tokens are never forwarded to another endpoint.
wire.settings.providers_lmstudio_base_ur: HTTP(S) API root. Changing servers requires a new token through /login; existing tokens are never forwarded to another endpoint.
HTTP(S) API root. Changing servers requires a new token through /login; existing tokens are never forwarded to another endpoint.
wire.settings.providers_openai_api.help: Direct OpenAI GPT-5 calls use the Responses API unless opted out.
wire.settings.providers_openai_api.label: OpenAI API surface
wire.settings.providers_openai_compatibl: HTTP(S) API root. Changing servers requires a new token through /login; existing tokens are never forwarded to another endpoint.
wire.settings.providers_openai_use_max_c: Off: provider default. On: supported max. Applies next request; compaction unchanged.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_allow: 'default' sends nothing (OpenRouter falls through to another host when the preferred one fails); 'false' fails rather than fall through to a host outside your preferences.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_data_: 'deny' excludes hosts that may train on or retain your prompts. 'default' sends no preference (OpenRouter's default: allow).
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_enfor: 'true': restrict to endpoints whose text output may be distilled. 'default': nothing sent.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_ignor: Empty = no opinion (sticky routing stays). Comma-separated block-list of host slugs to omit (e.g. a host that is failing right now) — may cost you the warm prompt cache.
Empty = no opinion (sticky routing stays). Comma-separated allow-list of host slugs; every other host is excluded — a forced cold start if the warm host is not on it.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_order: Empty = no opinion (sticky routing stays). Comma-separated host slugs tried in this exact order.
disables sticky routing — prompt cache goes cold
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_prefe: Prefer hosts whose time-to-first-token stays under this many seconds (p50). 0 sends no preference. A host above the bar is deprioritised, which may cost you a warm prompt cache.
Prefer hosts serving at least this many output tokens/sec (p50). 0 sends no preference. A host below the bar is deprioritised, which may cost you a warm prompt cache.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_provi: Reuses the host that served the previous turn so the prompt cache stays warm. Off = OpenRouter's price-weighted load balancing.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_quant: Empty = no opinion. Comma-separated quantization levels the served model may use (e.g. int8, fp8, mxfp4).
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_requi: only hosts that support every parameter
no preference — unsupported parameters may be dropped
'true' restricts to hosts that support every parameter you send (tools, structured output); 'default' lets OpenRouter silently drop unsupported ones.
no preference — sticky routing stays on (warmest cache)
How OpenRouter ranks hosts for this call. May route away from the host holding your warm prompt cache (a cold start on long conversations); 'default' sends no preference at all.
wire.settings.providers_openrouter_zdr.h: 'true': restrict to zero-data-retention endpoints. 'default': nothing sent.
wire.settings.providers_vllm_base_url.he: HTTP(S) API root. Changing servers requires a new token through /login; existing tokens are never forwarded to another endpoint.

wire.settings.shell_environment.descript: What a command the agent runs can see. Resolved once per session, so an edit here applies at the next launch and cannot weaken a session that is already running.
wire.settings.shell_environment.title: Agent shell
Empty = nothing removed. Names never handed to a command the agent runs, in either mode — including the session credential store's own injections, so this is how a variable is denied outright. Covers the bash and eval children only; MCP servers and the harness's own processes are not governed by it.
Empty = the safe set alone. Names the allowlist mode keeps ON TOP of the safe set — e.g. LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIG_DIR for a shell that must still resolve $(lop secret get NAME), or LANG. Inert in inherit mode.
wire.settings.shell_environment_mode.cho: the safe set plus the lists below, nothing else
wire.settings.shell_environment_mode.hel: 'inherit' lets a command the agent runs see your environment (gh, aws, npm keep their tokens). 'allowlist' passes only PATH/HOME/SHELL/TERM/USER/LOGNAME plus the two lists beside this, so the provider key this session launched with is not handed to a command the model writes. Read once per session: changing it takes effect at the next launch.

wire.settings.speech_voice_tone.label: Tone
wire.settings.static.description: Extra directories the local server may serve image, audio, video and HTML previews from. The agent home, session folders, uploads and the working directories of your agents and running sessions are always included.
wire.settings.static.title: File previews
wire.settings.static_roots.help: Empty = only the built-in roots. Comma-separated absolute directories; image/audio/video/HTML files inside them can be previewed. Dot-directories below a root are never served.
wire.settings.static_roots.label: Extra preview roots
wire.settings.static_roots.warning: widens what the local server will serve to any local caller
wire.settings.subagents.description: Concurrency cap, child knowledge slimming, who picks a child's model, and the model each tier runs on.
wire.settings.subagents.title: Subagents
wire.settings.subagents_max_running.help: Ceiling on concurrent subagents and backgrounded bash, which share one pool.
wire.settings.subagents_max_team_depth.h: Deepest launch allowed in a tree that runs a team. 1 is the top's children.
wire.settings.subagents_model_choice.cho: may run the subagent on a costlier model
wire.settings.subagents_model_choice.hel: Who picks a subagent's tier; the operator pins one in its profile.
wire.settings.subagents_models_hi.help: Bills at that model's rates; 'default': session; empty removes the tier
wire.settings.subagents_models_hi.label: Subagent model: hi
wire.settings.subagents_models_lo.help: Bills at that model's rates; 'default': session; empty removes the tier
wire.settings.subagents_models_lo.label: Subagent model: lo
wire.settings.subagents_models_med.help: Bills at that model's rates; 'default': session; empty removes the tier
wire.settings.subagents_models_med.label: Subagent model: med
wire.settings.subagents_slim_child_knowl: Keep skill/guide names; trim descriptions and parent extras.
wire.settings.supplements.description: After an answer, point out the files it produced and, when you turn it on, draw a chart of numbers it showed. Off by environment: LOP_SUPPLEMENTS=0.
wire.settings.supplements.title: Highlights
wire.settings.supplements_denyprefixes.h: Needs Highlights on. Comma-separated folders whose files are never listed or sent to a decision model; use it on a machine holding customer data.
wire.settings.supplements_enabled.choice: nothing is added under an answer
files an answer produced are pointed out under it
wire.settings.supplements_enabled.help: On: an answer can be followed by a line pointing at the files it made.
wire.settings.supplements_enabled.label: Highlights
wire.settings.supplements_files.help: Needs Highlights on. Point out reports and exports an answer produced.
wire.settings.supplements_files.label: ↳ files
wire.settings.supplements_graphics.choic: a chart may be generated (spends tokens)
wire.settings.supplements_graphics.help: Needs Highlights on. Draw a chart when an answer shows numbers. Spends model tokens.
wire.settings.supplements_graphics.label: ↳ graphics
wire.settings.supplements_maxcostusd.hel: Needs graphics on. Soft cap on one job's spend.
wire.settings.supplements_maxfeatured.he: Needs Highlights on. Files named before the rest fold into 'N more'.
wire.settings.supplements_maxoutputtoken: Needs graphics on. Output budget per generator turn.
wire.settings.supplements_maxturns.help: Needs graphics on. Model turns per chart, including one repair.
wire.settings.supplements_maxturns.label: ↳ max turns
wire.settings.supplements_model.help: Needs graphics on. auto picks a cheap fast model; session uses this session's.
wire.settings.supplements_model.label: ↳ graphics model
wire.settings.supplements_timeouts.help: Needs Highlights on. Give up on a whole job after this long.
wire.settings.supplements_timeouts.label: ↳ time limit (s)
wire.settings.tool_approval_mode.help: Loosening needs a write in this session — /approvals auto.
wire.settings.tool_approval_mode.label: Tool approval mode
wire.settings.tools.title: Tools
wire.settings.tools_defer.help: Keep rarely used tools' schemas out of every request until the agent reads tool://<name> or calls one. The tools stay callable either way. Off sends every schema on every request.
wire.settings.tools_defer.label: Load rarely used tool schemas on demand
wire.settings.tools_search_interception_: On: the command is refused with a suggestion. Off: it runs anyway and the interception is logged, so an operator can watch before enforcing.

Refuse a shell `grep`/`rg`/`find` that recurses from a repository root or a vendor/build tree, and point the agent at the `grep` tool. A scoped or single-file search is never touched. Off disables the check.
Give ripgrep a generated config that skips node_modules/.git/out etc., so an `rg` the guard does not block is still fast. Applies to ripgrep only.
wire.settings.tui_sidebar_position.choic: sessions to the left of the conversation
sessions to the right of the conversation
wire.settings.tui_sidebar_position.help: Which side of the conversation holds the session sidebar.
wire.settings.tui_sidebar_position.label: Sidebar position
wire.settings.tui_sidebar_show_subagents: List recent subagent runs below your own sessions. Ctrl+A toggles the layer while the sidebar has focus.
wire.settings.tui_sidebar_visible.help: Active and recent conversations. Ctrl+B toggles the sidebar.
wire.settings.tui_sidebar_visible.label: Session sidebar
wire.settings.tui_theme.help: Colour ramp. /theme switches it live with an arrow-key preview.
wire.settings.tui_theme.label: Theme
wire.settings.wakes.description: When a watched condition goes stale, the assistant is woken to check in rather than left to wait for the daily cadence: the master switch, the per-day budget and spacing, and which sources may fire. Read at the next evaluation pass.
wire.settings.wakes.title: Wake triggers
wire.settings.wakes_triggers_enabled.hel: Master switch for trigger wakes; off means no check-in is ever created.
wire.settings.wakes_triggers_max_per_day: Per-target rolling 24 h budget for trigger wakes. 0 disables trigger wakes without touching the switch above.
wire.settings.wakes_triggers_min_gap_min: Minimum spacing between trigger wakes to the same target.
wire.settings.wakes_triggers_project_sta: Wake to check in on projects whose progress went stale. Settled (done/paused/archived) projects are never watched.
wire.settings.web_fetch.description: Limits and rendering for the fetch tool.
wire.settings.web_fetch.title: Web fetch
wire.settings.web_fetch_allow_private.he: SSRF guard. On permits loopback, private and link-local targets.
wire.settings.web_fetch_blocked_retry.he: After a refusal, retry once with browser-shaped headers.
wire.settings.web_fetch_enabled.help: Offer the fetch tool and read <url>; off refuses every call.
wire.settings.web_fetch_enabled.label: Web fetch
wire.settings.web_fetch_enrich.help: Try .md, llms.txt and content negotiation before scraping HTML.
wire.settings.web_fetch_enrich.label: Enrich before scraping
wire.settings.web_fetch_max_attempts.hel: Retries share the call's timeout, so more attempts never take longer.
wire.settings.web_fetch_max_bytes.help: Enforced during streaming, so a huge page is cut off rather than buffered.
wire.settings.web_fetch_max_bytes.label: Download ceiling (bytes)
wire.settings.web_fetch_max_redirects.he: Redirect hops followed before giving up.
wire.settings.web_fetch_render_backend.h: Auto uses markdownify when the [fetch] extra is installed.
wire.settings.web_search.description: Providers and load balancing for the search tool.
wire.settings.web_search.title: Web search
wire.settings.web_search_deepseek_eviden: Adds a per-page quote and relevance score after a DeepSeek search.
wire.settings.web_search_enabled.help: Offer the search tool and let it run; off refuses every call.
wire.settings.web_search_enabled.label: Web search
wire.settings.web_search_excluded_provid: Never used, even in the automatic chain. Comma-separated; empty = none excluded.
wire.settings.web_search_providers.help: Comma-separated, in priority order; tried before the automatic free providers.
wire.settings.web_search_providers.label: Providers
wire.settings.web_search_read_enabled.he: Offer web_read: answer from pages a search already retrieved, no refetch.
wire.settings.web_search_searxng_endpoin: Base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance.
wire.settings.web_search_strategy.choice: top of the list first, fall through
wire.settings.web_search_strategy.help: How the provider list is consumed.
wire.settings.web_search_strategy.label: Load balancing
wire.settings.web_search_timeout_seconds: Per-provider request timeout. Clamped to 1-120 when read.
wire.settings.web_tools.description: Whether the search and fetch tools are offered and allowed to run.
wire.settings.web_tools.title: Web tools
